text_block_list.text: After my day out with Gold City...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Before we go back, there's somewhere I
want to
drop by first.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, follow me.
choice_data_list: 行きたいところ？

text_block_list.text:
Without telling me why, Gold City takes
me on
the train.

A blanket of silence falls between us
and I start
feeling a bit uncomfortable.
Where could she be
taking me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, this is amazing... It's exactly like in
the
magazine!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, in the issue we bought together
the other
day. It said this stream would
be a nice, quiet
place to relax!
choice_data_list: その雑誌に載っている場所なのか？
その雑誌に載っている場所なの？

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm going in!

Gold City takes off her shoes and dips
her feet
into the river.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Holy—it's freezing! Haha... It's not even
funny how
cold this is!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was just a leaf clinging to my leg.
That so
freaked me out.
choice_data_list: シチー！？

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you look closely, you can see
some fish
swimming around. Come here
and look!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! The stall over there says
they serve
grilled river fish. You never
see that in the city.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm getting one! I really want to try it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why not? C'mon, we can share one!
choice_data_list: 夕食前に食べて大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that was amazing. And I feel so

rejuvenated!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh, was I that obvious?
choice_data_list: ……気分転換になった？

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's nothing major.
choice_data_list: 何かあった？
何かあったの？

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I have a big show coming up, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And like, I'm used to having meetings, but there's been a lot for this one. More higher-ups have been attending, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So I guess... I just wanted to catch my
breath
before the show.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I guess I have.
choice_data_list: 今まで緊張の連続だったわけだ
今まで緊張の連続だったわけだね

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I just realized—I'm out here relaxing,
but this
is all still work for you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And it's supposed to be your day off
too. Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And it's supposed to be your day off
too. Sorry.
choice_data_list: 謝る必要はないぞ
謝る必要はないよ
貴重な時間を過ごさせてもらった
もうしたいことはないのか？
もうしたいことはないの？

text_block_list.text:
I tell her that good R&R leads to a good

performance.
choice_data_list: 謝る必要はないぞ
謝る必要はないよ
貴重な時間を過ごさせてもらった
もうしたいことはないのか？
もうしたいことはないの？

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yup, you are in work mode.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: でも、楽しかったからまた誘ってくれ
でも、楽しかったからまた誘って

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You really don't know how to take a
break, do
you? Guess I'll have to whisk
you away again.

I wonder where Gold City will take me
next time?
I grow a little excited just
thinking about it.

I tell her it's not every day I get a chance
to see
her in her natural element like
today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I guess there's no point trying to
put on a
"cool" act at this stage.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I should warn you, though—don't tell anyone how much I let myself loose today.
choice_data_list: シチー？

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.
choice_data_list: わかってる、秘密な
わかってる、秘密ね

text_block_list.text:
Today, I got to see a whole new side of
Gold
City.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: With my bare hands?
choice_data_list: 素手で魚を捕まえるとか

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pfft... hahaha!
choice_data_list: 葉っぱで船を作って競走するとか！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: How old do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
More like... it's a unique idea. It does
feel
nostalgic, though.
choice_data_list: ダメか～
ダメかな～

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Well, try to make a more thoughtful suggestion next time we go out, okay?

I'll have to work on making better
proposals, but
it was a relief to see Gold
City more relaxed.
